rules.summary: Use exactly one graph root; session and state_machine are not accepted by Resource Gateway authoring.
Give the graph a stable identifier followed by a braced member block.
Declare each operator node as node name : operatorRef and use only references returned by this snapshot.
Place input, output, dependency, timeout and retry declarations inside the node body.
An operator whose bindingState is DESIGN_ONLY can express intent but cannot support executable or publication claims until a governed runtime binding exists.
Assign each named input from ctx or an upstream node output inside an input block.
Use only input and output port names returned in the selected operator contracts; never invent a generic input or output name.
Read an upstream named output as nodeName.output.portName and preserve the schema carried by that port.
Use String, Int, Number and Boolean for scalar declarations; a question mark marks an optional value.
Declare reusable object shapes with schema and reference the schema name from typed outputs or transform fields.
Use array literals for collection values and only collection functions returned in the current function contracts.
Declare each output field as name = expression; an optional type annotation precedes the equals sign.
Transform expressions may use only deterministic functions in the current function contracts; runtime effects are not allowed.
Name every decision input and declare a structured result type.
For hit=unique, keep rules non-overlapping and include an otherwise rule when inputs are not exhaustive.
Represent adjacent policy boundaries explicitly; for a threshold at 120, verify 119, 120 and 121 as separate GOLDEN cases.
Use depends_on only for an explicit ordering dependency that is not already implied by a data binding.
Use finite timeout and retry controls; retry requires attempts, backoff and a supported strategy.
Treat effect and bindingState in the operator contract as authoritative; preview does not prove live execution readiness.
Call only functions and signatures returned in this authoring context; do not infer a function from general BLOGE documentation.
Use a returned null-handling function such as coalesce only when its current signature accepts the supplied value types.
Preview, gate and compose the same source under the same authoring context and receipt fingerprints.
Compose only when roundTrip.status is SUPPORTED; do not repair semantic drift by editing the server projection.
For DSL_PARSE_ERROR, reopen the referenced graph syntax and revise the smallest affected construct; do not infer a missing token that the diagnostic did not declare.
Choose only a visible compatible contract or a declared named port; never guess from a similar display name.
Use blocking=true rather than severity to identify blockers; stop after three repair rounds or two identical blocking fingerprint sets and report the prescribed non-technical next action.

topics.title: Feature, Scenario, Instruction and Solution contracts

rules.summary: Define one atomic typed fact with output.type, evaluationKind, determinism, inputs and the matching evaluation or interaction reference.
Define a pure unique-hit decision with declared inputs, ordered rules, typed outlets, complete target bindings and a mandatory otherwise outlet.
Define inputs and an output containing structured result plus required reasoning; every WRITE also declares downstream reconciliation and may remain design-only without bindingRef.
Map each function input to a Feature reference, select one root Scenario, enumerate allowed Instructions and bind one GOLDEN case set.

A Solution consumes already-collected feature values and lowers only to scenarioCall followed by instructionCall; never add featureCall, interaction, waiting or an external read to the Solution graph.
Use topic graph-root for the current authoritative graph-root rules.
Use topic node-declaration for the current authoritative node rules.
Use topic node-bindings for the current authoritative binding rules.
Use topic execution-controls for current effect and runtime-readiness rules.
